subject: Thursday walkthrough — need to shift start time?

Subject: Thursday walkthrough — need to shift start time?

Hi Emily / Tom —

Quick note ahead of Thursday's walkthrough (scheduled 11/18 @ 11:00am PT). Our VP just told us they'll need to hop on for the first 20 minutes but their flight now arrives earlier the same day, so they'd prefer a start that's ~45 minutes earlier if possible.

One wrinkle: Karthik (SE) just flagged he's double-booked at the earlier slot with an existing customer commitment and may not be able to move. To avoid dropping technical coverage, here are options I can propose quickly:

- Option A: Move the meeting 45–60 minutes earlier (start 10:00–10:15am PT). VP can join live and we keep the full walkthrough intact.
- Option B: Keep the current time; Marcus Lin (senior SE) covers the technical portion and Karthik follows up with a recorded deep dive and Q&A the next week.
- Option C: Split: 25-minute exec-focused demo earlier for the VP, then schedule a 30–40 minute technical deep-dive later the same day or next week.

I've attached a quick screenshot of available alternate slots (calendar-options.png). Can you let me know which you prefer? If you need us to pick, I recommend Option A (move to 10:00am PT) so exec can join live and we can keep momentum.

Thanks —
Jasmine

--
Jasmine Liu

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the heads up. Our VP would prefer to join live if possible, but moving earlier becomes tight for one of our product leads who has standing calls at 10am PT. If you can guarantee SE coverage, we can keep the current time (11:00am PT). Otherwise we can do a shortened exec-first session earlier.

If Option B (Marcus covers) is viable, we'd go with that — but we do want the full technical recording and an opportunity for live Q&A with Karthik within the following week.

Appreciate the flexibility — Emily

Emily Sanchez

Hey team —

Sorry, I should have mentioned earlier: I can't move my other customer meeting on Thursday; it's a multi-party session and the customer has limited availability. I'm traveling (train into SFO) and that earlier slot conflicts with transit.

I'm happy to do any of the following:
- Have Marcus Lin take the technical lead on Thursday (Marcus is briefed on the Greenline case).
- If you prefer a live Karthik session, we can schedule a 60-minute deep dive on Mon/Tue next week (I have availability Mon 11/22 9–11am PT or Tue 11/23 1–4pm PT).

If Marcus covers, I'll provide a 15–20 minute pre-recorded tech walkthrough and a short doc with configs to share on the call.

Thanks all — quick plan to keep this simple:

- We're going to move the meeting 1x earlier by 1 hour to 10:00am PT on Thursday so the VP can join live. (Shorter shift than originally discussed but should do the trick.)
- Marcus will be primary SE for Thursday at 10:00am PT. Marcus, can you cover the technical walkthrough and keep 15–20 minutes at the end for live Q&A? Karthik will provide a ~15-minute recorded tech walkthrough and the config summary doc before the call.
- If Greenline prefers Marcus to be more hands-on, Karthik can join the Q&A portion remotely if transit allows.

I'll send an updated calendar invite (updated-invite.ics) and attach a 1-page exec brief for your VP (redwood-exec-brief.pdf). We'll also record the session and share the recording.

Emily/Tom — can you confirm that 10:00am PT on Thursday works? If yes I'll update the invite and include dial-in + recording consent.

Cheers,
Jasmine
